metadata.description: Agent skills by Shahar Shavit for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Agent-Skills-compatible harnesses

plugins.name: shaharsha-skills
plugins.description: All 26 agent skills - gdoc-sync, gslides-sync, gsheets, presentation-generator, elevenlabs-tts, elevenlabs-stt, narrating-pptx, deck-to-video, self-presenting-decks, writing-plainly, brand-system, brand-assets, image-generation, prompt-engineer, writing-project-instructions, tech-design-doc, namecheap-domains, office-render, viewing-videos, proton-pass, excalidraw-diagrams, tavily-extract, pair-intelligence, reviving-sessions, generating-video-clips, producing-animated-episodes

plugins.name: documents-and-decks
plugins.description: Sync Markdown to Google Docs, .pptx to Google Slides, CSV / values to Google Sheets, generate AI-rendered 16:9 presentation decks, generate ElevenLabs Eleven v4 speech with audio-tag direction, transcribe speech and make subtitles with ElevenLabs Scribe v3, add per-slide voice narration with autoplay to any pptx, turn narrated decks into self-playing mp4 videos, orchestrate the whole deck-to-narration-to-video chain, and write messages, emails, updates and tickets that read plainly and not like AI

plugins.name: brand-and-visuals
plugins.description: Author production-grade brand books, run logo / favicon / icon-pack pipelines, generate AI imagery via GPT Image 2.5 (Sunburst, Flare) and Gemini Nano Banana, and build architecture / flow / system diagrams in Excalidraw

plugins.name: engineering-decisions
plugins.description: Author and audit technical design docs, RFCs, and ADRs, and consult a second model (OpenAI Codex or Google Gemini) to review a plan or diff, give a second opinion, brainstorm, research, or browse before it lands

plugins.name: building-agents
plugins.description: Expert prompt-engineering reference for AI agents on Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, and Grok APIs, plus authoring CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md project-instruction files

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Domain availability via Namecheap API; rendering Microsoft Office files (.docx/.pptx/.xlsx) to PDF/images via the real Office apps on macOS; viewing video files (mp4/mov) by extracting the fewest frames that answer the question; managing credentials and secrets via the Proton Pass CLI (pass-cli); plus fetching JavaScript-rendered or bot-blocked web pages that WebFetch can't, via the Tavily Extract API

plugins.name: video-production
plugins.description: Produce voiced, subtitled, lip-synced animated episodes from photos and a script with one config-driven engine; animate stills with Gemini Omni and lip-sync dialogue with Sync 3 on fal

plugins.name: gdoc-sync
plugins.description: Only the gdoc-sync skill. Push a local .md to an existing Google Doc, fixing what Google's converter breaks (#anchor links, cross-doc refs, 1500pt images, missing RTL), re-applying the styling each push resets, and refusing to overwrite edits made in the Doc since the last sync.

plugins.name: gslides-sync
plugins.description: Only the gslides-sync skill. The same shape for .pptx → an existing Google Slides: native pageObjectId links, scaled images, RTL per text shape, warnings for what the import drops, and the command that restores narration videos a push deleted.

plugins.name: gsheets
plugins.description: Only the gsheets skill. Sheets API v4 CLI: read as records, find rows, compare-and-set writes for shared Sheets, one-call table layout, validation, inspect and export, plus a raw batchUpdate with A1 ranges. Runs on a bare python3.

plugins.name: presentation-generator
plugins.description: Only the presentation-generator skill. 16:9 PDF + PPTX decks where every slide is a custom AI-rendered image. Style locks globally; composition varies per slide.

plugins.name: elevenlabs-tts
plugins.description: Only the elevenlabs-tts skill. Speech with ElevenLabs Eleven v4 in any language — short spoken briefings ("explain this to me as an MP3"), v4 audio-tag direction, consistent 429-safe batches, a speech-to-text check that no tag was read aloud, and forced-alignment timings for subtitles.

plugins.name: elevenlabs-stt
plugins.description: Only the elevenlabs-stt skill. Transcripts and subtitles with ElevenLabs Scribe v3 in any language: meetings, talks and YouTube links into timestamped, speaker-labelled transcript.md and clean SRT, keyterms and a clean mode that keep English terms in Latin script inside Hebrew speech, and live transcription over the Scribe v3 Live WebSocket.

plugins.name: narrating-pptx
plugins.description: Only the narrating-pptx skill. Per-slide ElevenLabs narration embedded in a pptx, with autoplay authored by real PowerPoint — the one method that doesn't corrupt the file — or added to a Google Slides deck as autoplaying Drive videos.

plugins.name: deck-to-video
plugins.description: Only the deck-to-video skill. Slides + narration → a self-playing mp4 with a progress bar, countdown, and slide counter, baked with PIL because ffmpeg's animated drawbox silently renders full.

plugins.name: self-presenting-decks
plugins.description: Only the self-presenting-decks skill. The orchestration map over the whole chain, plus the update matrix for what to rebuild when something changes.

plugins.name: writing-plainly
plugins.description: Only the writing-plainly skill. Messages, emails, updates, PR descriptions and tickets that people read to the end and that don't read as AI: one recipe, a shape per genre, Slack and email specifics, Hebrew rules, and a checker for the mechanical tells.

plugins.name: brand-system
plugins.description: Only the brand-system skill. A production-grade brand book: 20-section BRAND.md, printable PDF sibling, and matched tokens.css (Tailwind v4) + tokens.json (W3C DTCG). WCAG 2.2 AA audited at authoring time.

plugins.name: brand-assets
plugins.description: Only the brand-assets skill. The mechanical-pixel sibling: vectorize, finalize-svg, rasterize, icon-pack, colour-audit. Bash + Python stdlib.

plugins.name: image-generation
plugins.description: Only the image-generation skill. Logos, icons, mockups, and product shots via OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 (Sunburst for finals, Flare for drafts) or Gemini Nano Banana — each prompted in its provider's native grammar, with native transparent PNGs.

plugins.name: prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Only the prompt-engineer skill. Prompt and context engineering for the Claude / GPT / Gemini / Kimi / Grok APIs — system prompts, tool descriptions, provider differences, agent harness patterns (approvals, modes, async work, compaction), judge-prompt design.

plugins.name: writing-project-instructions
plugins.description: Only the writing-project-instructions skill. Author or audit a CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md, with the falsifiability test and the loading semantics people usually get wrong.

plugins.name: tech-design-doc
plugins.description: Only the tech-design-doc skill. RFCs, ADRs, KEPs, and partner-mode TDRs, triaged to the right format first and audited against documented anti-patterns.

plugins.name: namecheap-domains
plugins.description: Only the namecheap-domains skill. Domain availability via Namecheap's API — one domain, batches of 50, or TLD sweeps, with premium and EAP fees surfaced.

plugins.name: office-render
plugins.description: Only the office-render skill. Render .docx / .pptx / .xlsx to PDF and page images using the real Office apps on macOS — pixel-faithful, unlike LibreOffice.

plugins.name: viewing-videos
plugins.description: Only the viewing-videos skill. How an agent sees a video: the fewest ffmpeg frames that answer the question, triaged on a contact sheet.

plugins.name: proton-pass
plugins.description: Only the proton-pass skill. Credentials and secrets from the CLI via Proton Pass, with never-print-secrets guardrails.

plugins.name: excalidraw-diagrams
plugins.description: Only the excalidraw-diagrams skill. Architecture and flow diagrams on an Excalidraw+ canvas with real tech icons, plus the MCP quirks that silently break a diagram.

plugins.name: tavily-extract
plugins.description: Only the tavily-extract skill. Fetch the JS-rendered SPAs and 403-blocked hosts a normal fetcher can't, and flag soft 404s.

plugins.name: pair-intelligence
plugins.description: Only the pair-intelligence skill. Consult a second model (Codex or Gemini) to review, advise, brainstorm, research or browse, then judge every claim against the source. Replaces codex-review.

plugins.name: reviving-sessions
plugins.description: Only the reviving-sessions skill. Bring back sessions the Claude desktop app cannot see — adopt CLI and headless sessions into it, fix renames, recover stranded transcripts, and read what an ended session said.

plugins.name: generating-video-clips
plugins.description: Only the generating-video-clips skill. Still to short clip with Gemini Omni, takes reviewed on frame sheets, and mouths lip-synced to your own dialogue with Sync 3 on fal, one speaker per part, frame-exact.

plugins.name: producing-animated-episodes
plugins.description: Only the producing-animated-episodes skill. A voiced, subtitled, animated, lip-synced vertical episode from photos and a script: one episode.json, one engine, human gates at every paid step, timing driven by the real dialogue.
